title: Intake routing and operational triage
description: Use when handling incoming LPM requests: route an intake entry or WhatsApp protocol (protocolo) to a project, triage operational entries (bugs, incidents), merge duplicates, convert one to an activity, record a reply. Old name: workspace-routing-operator. Not for AISH job files (use lpm-aish-jobs).
doneWhen: The intake entry is routed (or explicitly deferred/rejected) with its entries verified, or entries are curated as decided.
authorityCeiling: Reads and previews [A]; AI triage proposal [A]; routing review, entry creation, curation, merge, conversion, protocol evidence and reply receipts [C].
jobs: qual é o status do protocolo <código>? o que aconteceu com ele?
roteie esta demanda do WhatsApp para o projeto certo
faça a triagem das entradas operacionais novas do projeto
which project should receive intake entry <intakeEntryId>?

route intake to project

(the owner chose it)

notFor.when: reference files, audio or transcripts for an AISH job
evidence (print, log, report) for an LPM activity
AISH delivery artifacts or a DoD audit
planning the activity after conversion (owner, cycle, dates)
project settings other than the routing profile
routing policy, escalation policy or executive context
linking the request to work in another workspace
a project or portfolio health review
reviewing a change set before publication
what the code says about the reported problem

references.loadWhen: playbook route-intake: route an intake to one project the owner chose
playbook route-split: split an intake across two projects the owner chose
playbook route-reject-or-defer: reject or defer an intake
playbook register-report: register a report without an intake entry
playbook classify-entry: classify an entry, or get an AI proposal
playbook decide-entry: approve, reject or defer an entry
playbook merge-duplicates: find or merge duplicate entries
playbook entry-to-activity: turn an entry into an activity, or link one
playbook protocol-record: attach a stored file to a protocol, or log a reply

codex.shortDescription: Route LPM intake and triage operational entries
codex.defaultPrompt: Use $lpm-intake-triage to route LPM intake protocol <protocolCode> to the right project.
